name: @a2m8/api-contracts
description: API contracts between the college LMS backend and the services it calls.

scripts.bundle:course-outline: redocly bundle course-outline/openapi.yaml -o dist/course-outline.openapi.json && redocly bundle course-outline/openapi.yaml -o dist/course-outline.openapi.yaml
scripts.bundle:content-generation: redocly bundle content-generation/openapi.yaml -o dist/content-generation.openapi.json && redocly bundle content-generation/openapi.yaml -o dist/content-generation.openapi.yaml
scripts.bundle: npm run bundle:course-outline && npm run bundle:content-generation
scripts.docs:course-outline: redocly build-docs course-outline/openapi.yaml -o docs/course-outline.html --disableGoogleFont && node build/inline-docs.mjs docs/course-outline.html
scripts.docs:content-generation: redocly build-docs content-generation/openapi.yaml -o docs/content-generation.html --disableGoogleFont && node build/inline-docs.mjs docs/content-generation.html
scripts.docs: npm run docs:course-outline && npm run docs:content-generation && node build/write-docs-index.mjs
scripts.split: npm run split:course-outline && npm run split:content-generation
scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run bundle && node web/scripts/embed-spec.mjs && npm run docs
scripts.web: npm run bundle && npm --prefix web run dev
